---
title: "Explore backpropagation"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Backpropagation computes how the loss changes with every trainable parameter.
This explorer traces that calculation for one labeled observation, then applies
the mean gradient from the entire toy dataset to update the network.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Click a data point to choose the observation used in the visible trace. The
network first makes a prediction, then carries the error signal backward to
compute parameter gradients. A training update, however, uses the average
gradient across all labeled observations.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="nn-backprop-explorer" class="nn-backprop-explorer" aria-label="Interactive neural-network backpropagation explorer">
  <div class="nn-backprop-toolbar clt-buttons">
    <button id="nn-backprop-step" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Step through update</button>
    <button id="nn-backprop-run" type="button">Run 50 updates</button>
    <button id="nn-backprop-reset" type="button">Reset example</button>
    <output id="nn-backprop-status" class="nn-forward-status" aria-live="polite">Ready to trace one training update</output>
  </div>

  <div class="nn-backprop-workbench">
    <section class="nn-workbench-panel nn-backprop-process-panel" aria-labelledby="nn-backprop-process-heading">
      <div class="nn-workbench-heading">
        <h2 id="nn-backprop-process-heading">One training update</h2>
        <p>Follow one selected observation, then use the full dataset for the update.</p>
      </div>
      <ol id="nn-backprop-timeline" class="nn-backprop-timeline" aria-label="Backpropagation update stages"></ol>
    </section>

    <section class="nn-workbench-panel nn-backprop-network-panel" aria-labelledby="nn-backprop-network-heading">
      <div class="nn-workbench-heading">
        <h2 id="nn-backprop-network-heading">Forward and backward pass</h2>
        <p>Colored connections correspond to rows of <i>W</i><sup>[1]</sup>; the blue overlay shows an error signal moving backward.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="nn-backprop-controls">
        <label for="nn-backprop-rate">Learning rate &eta;</label>
        <input id="nn-backprop-rate" type="range" min="0.02" max="0.5" step="0.01" value="0.20" aria-label="Learning rate">
        <output id="nn-backprop-rate-value">0.20</output>
        <div id="nn-backprop-dataset-controls" class="nn-dataset-controls" aria-label="Toy dataset controls"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="nn-backprop-stage">
        <figure class="nn-forward-figure nn-backprop-architecture-figure">
          <svg id="nn-backprop-network" role="img" aria-label="Two-input, three-hidden-unit, one-output neural network with backpropagation trace"></svg>
        </figure>
        <figure class="nn-forward-figure nn-backprop-plane-figure">
          <svg id="nn-backprop-plane" role="img" aria-label="Toy binary-classification observations and current predicted positive-label probability"></svg>
          <figcaption>Click a labeled point to select the trace observation.</figcaption>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="nn-backprop-lower-grid">
      <section class="nn-workbench-panel nn-backprop-trace-panel" aria-labelledby="nn-backprop-trace-heading">
        <div class="nn-workbench-heading">
          <h2 id="nn-backprop-trace-heading">Selected-observation trace</h2>
          <p id="nn-backprop-trace-description">A local calculation for one labeled observation.</p>
        </div>
        <div id="nn-backprop-trace" class="nn-backprop-trace"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="nn-workbench-panel nn-backprop-parameter-panel" aria-labelledby="nn-backprop-parameter-heading">
        <div class="nn-workbench-heading">
          <h2 id="nn-backprop-parameter-heading">Parameters and full-dataset gradient</h2>
          <p>The update uses the mean gradient over every toy observation.</p>
        </div>
        <div id="nn-backprop-parameters" class="nn-backprop-parameters"></div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <section class="nn-backprop-gradient-equations" aria-label="Layerwise backpropagation gradients">
      <div class="nn-backprop-equation-copy">
        <strong>Layerwise gradients</strong>
        <span>First compute an error signal for each layer, then use those signals to form the gradients for every parameter.</span>
      </div>
      <div class="nn-backprop-gradient-formulas">
        <div class="nn-backprop-formula-row">
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula-label">Network shapes</span>
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula nn-backprop-shape-formula">
            <i>X</i> &isin; &#8477;<sup><i>n</i>&times;2</sup>,
            <i>Y</i> &isin; &#8477;<sup><i>n</i>&times;1</sup>,
            <i>W</i><sup>[1]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup>3&times;2</sup>,
            <i>b</i><sup>[1]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup>1&times;3</sup> &rarr; <i>B</i><sup>[1]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup><i>n</i>&times;3</sup>,
            <i>Z</i><sup>[1]</sup>, <i>A</i><sup>[1]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup><i>n</i>&times;3</sup>,
            <i>W</i><sup>[2]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup>1&times;3</sup>,
            <i>b</i><sup>[2]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup>1&times;1</sup> &rarr; <i>B</i><sup>[2]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup><i>n</i>&times;1</sup>,
            <i>Z</i><sup>[2]</sup>, <i>A</i><sup>[2]</sup> &isin; &#8477;<sup><i>n</i>&times;1</sup>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="nn-backprop-formula-row">
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula-label">Hidden activation</span>
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula">
            <i>g</i>(<i>z</i>) = max(0, <i>z</i>) &nbsp; (ReLU),
            &nbsp;&nbsp;
            <i>g</i>&prime;(<i>z</i>) =
            <span class="nn-backprop-piecewise">1 if <i>z</i> &gt; 0; 0 otherwise</span>
            <span class="nn-backprop-annotation">elementwise</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="nn-backprop-formula-row">
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula-label">Error signals</span>
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula">
            <i>&delta;</i><sup>[2]</sup> = <i>A</i><sup>[2]</sup> &minus; <i>Y</i>,
            &nbsp;&nbsp;
            <i>&delta;</i><sup>[1]</sup> =
            (<i>&delta;</i><sup>[2]</sup><i>W</i><sup>[2]</sup>)
            &odot; <i>g</i>&prime;(<i>Z</i><sup>[1]</sup>)
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="nn-backprop-formula-row">
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula-label">Output layer</span>
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula">
            &part;<i>L</i>/&part;<i>W</i><sup>[2]</sup> =
            <span class="nn-backprop-fraction"><span>1</span><span><i>n</i></span></span>
            (<i>&delta;</i><sup>[2]</sup>)<sup>T</sup><i>A</i><sup>[1]</sup>,
            &nbsp;&nbsp;
            &part;<i>L</i>/&part;<i>b</i><sup>[2]</sup> = <code>mean</code>(<i>&delta;</i><sup>[2]</sup>)
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="nn-backprop-formula-row">
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula-label">Hidden layer</span>
          <span class="nn-backprop-formula">
            &part;<i>L</i>/&part;<i>W</i><sup>[1]</sup> =
            <span class="nn-backprop-fraction"><span>1</span><span><i>n</i></span></span>
            (<i>&delta;</i><sup>[1]</sup>)<sup>T</sup><i>X</i>,
            &nbsp;&nbsp;
            &part;<i>L</i>/&part;<i>b</i><sup>[1]</sup> = <code>mean</code>(<i>&delta;</i><sup>[1]</sup>)
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="nn-workbench-panel nn-backprop-metrics-panel" aria-labelledby="nn-backprop-metrics-heading">
      <div class="nn-workbench-heading">
        <h2 id="nn-backprop-metrics-heading">Training progress</h2>
        <p>Full-dataset binary cross-entropy and classification accuracy.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="nn-backprop-progress-grid">
        <div id="nn-backprop-metrics" class="nn-backprop-metrics nn-backprop-progress-summary"></div>
        <figure class="nn-backprop-loss-figure">
          <figcaption>Training loss vs. update</figcaption>
          <svg id="nn-backprop-loss-chart" viewBox="0 0 520 190" role="img" aria-label="Training loss as a function of the number of gradient updates"></svg>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
```
